insights.one_liner: American outdoor clothing company and certified B-Corp known for environmental activism, with an English-language finance role in Amsterdam and IND sponsor status.

culture.text: Outdoor apparel company founded by Yvon Chouinard in 1973, a certified B-Corp whose mission is to save our home planet.
Looks for people who love the outdoors and have passions outside work, from surfing to community activism.
About 3,848 people on LinkedIn, headquartered in Ventura, California; overseas offices hire only occasionally.

open.text: Recognised IND sponsor through Patagonia Consultants B.V. and Patagonia Europe Coöperatief U.A.
Its one current opening, a mid-level finance role in Amsterdam, does not ask for Dutch.

worth_knowing.text: Gave a $100 credit to 112,000 people who helped friends plan to vote in the US midterms, as its CEO criticised political apathy.
Joined ACT to support living wages across global supply chains.
Donates 1% of sales annually and has given over $100 million in grants and in-kind donations since 1985.
